alt: A short film with no voice. A kitchen on a flat amber field with a shelf of jars. Two small block figures with doorway legs and white eyes, one in ink and one in tomato red, stand on either side of a low table with a plate and a single taco. They push the plate back and forth, faster and faster, to the beat. Then a second taco pops onto the plate and both pairs of eyes grow wide. The sentence For whoever gets the other half this Thursday stays on screen the whole time; Tacos? appears near the end. The last card reads Closer to yourself.
